_provenance.readout: one forward; the LM head's next-token read on the label tokens at the answer slot; two-way (bidirectional) attention over the whole prompt
_provenance.serving: bash h2o-lightning-4b/serve.sh (ONE_ENGINE=1, --attention-backend TRITON_ATTN, MAX_LEN 40960, shipped serve_config.json)
_provenance.vllm_build_check: engine/vllm_per_request_attention.SHA256SUMS (30 files; sha256sum -c and serve.sh on every start)
_provenance.command: python3 -m jevbench.cli run --tasks <INTERNAL>/dev_tasks.jsonl --adapter typesafe --endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8741 --key-env '' --model h2oai/h2o-lightning-4b --cost-basis self_hosted_gpu --reserve-usd 0 --results <OUT>/results.jsonl --raw-dir <OUT>/raw --ledger <OUT>/ledger.jsonl --manifest <OUT>/manifest.json --run-label h2o-lightning-4b-dev --delay-s 0
_provenance.exclusion: withheld_gold abstention items: the gold label is deliberately absent from the criteria, so a typed readout over the supplied options cannot score them; excluded, not counted wrong
_provenance.task_conversion: TypedQuestion jsonl -> harness task rows: choice labels are the criteria keys and the expected value is the record label; noul labels are [no, yes] and the expected value is yes/no from the boolean; score labels are 0..K-1 and the expected value is the integer level. Rows whose gold label is absent from the options (label_kind withheld_gold) are excluded.
